product.name: Dual-Band WiFi Range Extender
product.specification: Plug-in dual-band repeater, 2.4GHz and 5GHz, one WPS pairing button, wall-socket mounted, single indicator LED.
problems_solved: The far end of the house drops off the network and nothing in the room shows why
Video calls stall in the back bedroom while the router two walls away reports full health
Adding a second router means running cable through the house
raw_features: Plugs into a wall socket and pairs with one button press — no app, no cable, no configuration screen
Repeats both bands, so a device keeps the band it was already using
One indicator LED reports signal strength at the chosen socket, so the socket can be moved before it is trusted
personas: Households in older or long-plan homes, 25-65, whose router cannot be moved and whose problem appears only at the far end of the house

sections.copy_summary: Setup is one action: put it in a socket halfway to the dead room and press the pair button once. Nothing to install, nothing to configure, no second step.

image_slots.position: setup block, beside the one-line instruction

sections.copy_summary: The closing beat: the back bedroom works. Nothing about the result is photographable — no output, no mark on an object, no change on a body — so the tile has to carry the state rather than the evidence.

image_slots.position: closing block above the final CTA
